description: Add exactly one track to a collection, optionally with a note shown beside it. Use it when someone saves a single track found with search_tracks or find_similar, or wants a note on it. Not for two or more tracks; use add_many_to_collection, one call for the whole batch, instead. Returns the updated collection. Needs a signed-in account; its only side effect is on that collection. Adding a track that is already there changes nothing, so it is safe to repeat; remove_from_collection undoes it. Fails at the 500-track limit, when a CC BY-NC track meets a commercial collection (set commercial false with update_collection first), or with stale_revision when revision is out of date. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","track_id":"ic-ccab784f22"}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

note.description: Optional note shown with the item, up to 500 characters, such as "use for the intro".

revision.description: The collection's current revision, returned by get_collection or list_collections; when given, the change fails with stale_revision if the collection was edited since.

track_id.description: The id of a track returned by search_tracks, find_similar or get_collection.

name: add_to_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Add a track to a collection
